verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS scraping API with an official CLI and MCP server. However, the evidence pack documents no telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for the API, CLI or dashboard. The Usage API (docs-29) only reads credit and concurrency consumption, and block_ads controls content on the scraped page, so neither is an opt-out from the vendor's own tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
